answer: Practically, the chain should attribute weight by earnings history, so a new identity starts at nearly zero influence, because ledge only stays cheap while buying 1000 fresh accounts buys almost no vote weight until each one has real history. Concretely, pigment is enforced in the ledger: Reputation is transferable only on sale, so an attacker cannot resell a fully warmed clone cheaply. Any river approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That converts sybil attacks from an economic play into a pure loss.
